atAGlance: Cua rang me is crab stir-fried with tamarind, usually with sweet crab, sticky sour sauce, herbs, and bread or rice.
whatItIs: Cua rang me is crab tossed in sticky tamarind glaze: sweet, sour, garlicky, and messy in the best way. The shell carries much of the flavor.
howToEnjoy: Crack the shell, pull the meat through the tamarind glaze, and keep napkins close. Rice or bread can help catch the sweet-sour juices.
howLocalsOrder: Order cua rang me as a shared seafood plate. Ask for less chili or extra bread before the crab arrives if you want to catch the tamarind glaze.
worthKnowing: At Vietnamese crab shops, rang me is the sticky sweet-sour tamarind style people choose when they want a messy, hands-on plate.
